1. **Form.** Draft, base `main`, body line 1 `Fixes #13246`, `Clause-②: no` on its own line; the only closing keyword is line 1. Files: `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` (+21/−3), `DrawerForm.tsx` (+14/−3), the touched `__tests__/modalSectionToggleSuspense-12559.test.tsx`, the new `__tests__/sectionOpenKeepsFocus-13246.test.tsx`, `.changeset/13246-section-open-keeps-focus.md`. NOT governed, +289/−8. `form.tsx`, `fieldGroups.ts` and `ObjectForm.tsx` untouched; no export or prop.
2. **Premise and route.** The mechanism held with one correction measured by the dev: the suspended toggle hid the drawn body with `display: none` (hidden, not unmounted), and the browser drops focus from a hidden element. `DrawerForm` shares the shape, worse: with no boundary of its own the host's fallback hid the drawer. The fix makes each form's two section-toggle sites go through one `setSectionCollapsed`, a `startTransition`, so the drawn form stays on screen until the group's rows can draw. The suggested per-field boundary was not taken, for a measured reason: the widget is `FormControl`'s single `Slot` child, and a per-field boundary would change every form's first draw. Assumption 3 did not fully hold. One assertion of the first objectui#12559 case required the body placeholder mid-load, and that placeholder is what hid the focused header. It now asserts the body stays drawn. A new case keeps the dialog's body boundary pinned on an ordinary update (the body's first draw), and the other #12559 cases are unchanged. The seat reads this as the pin following the fix, not a weakened one: #12559's own invariants (the dialog never remounts, nothing above it waits, the typed value survives) are all still asserted. A double click while loading cannot close the group again: the toggle's next value comes from the rendered state, so both clicks ask for "open".
3. **Gates (check-runs on `583c45f`, 36 runs):** 33 `success` (`Lint` and `Type Check` included), 3 `skipped` by design on a PR (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, the coverage shard matrix).
4. **Seat's live reading (real keyboard, fresh page session so the widget chunk is not cached).** Review stack: the console at this head on a vite server started fresh on this tree, against an objectstack showcase backend at `9d13b5fc8`; Chromium 1440x900; Showcase → Semantic Zoo → New, the collapsed "Money" group.
   - At this head: Tab from the first field reaches the "Money" header, and Enter opens the group (`amount` and `budget` drawn). Focus is still on the header (`DIV role=button`, "Money"), and the next Tab lands on `amount`. Later toggles keep focus too: Space closes, Enter reopens, Tab reaches `amount`.
   - Control at `e70c21d` (the PR's parent), fresh server, same steps: after the first Enter, focus was on the dialog's `role="dialog"` element and the next Tab started again at `status`, the card's defect.
   - Not read live: the drawer arm. Its pin, and the ablation that removes `DrawerForm`'s transition, cover it.
5. **Changeset prose, checked sentence by sentence.** "In the record dialog … that wait hid the whole dialog body, and the header … with it … focus came back to the dialog itself, so the next Tab started again at the dialog's first field" (the control); "The record drawer … the same toggle hid everything under the host's nearest loading boundary" (the dev's probe and the drawer pin, red on base); "Later toggles were not affected" (the control's later toggles); "Both forms now open and close a section as a React transition … The header keeps focus … the next Tab reaches the section's first field" (point 4; the transition ablations turn the pins red); "The dialog keeps its own loading placeholder for every other wait, such as the first draw of its body" (the new #12559 case; removing the body boundary turns only it red). All hold.
6. **Out-of-scope routing.** `ObjectForm`'s full-page form has the same toggle path but no reach (no example declares `editMode`, which routes the console to it); a `visibleWhen` that reveals a not-yet-loaded widget is still an ordinary update (read from source, not measured). Both stay Acceptance notes.
